_about: Samuel Ridout (1855-1930), American Brethren Bible teacher (Loizeaux Brothers), for the Word Hoard. Added 2026-11-15 from Adam's Libronix list ('Libronix authors - reconciled.md' and its companion manifests: Serious Christian Volumes, add-on SER), which carries his King Saul, How to Study the Bible and The Bible the True University. Not George W. Ridout, the Methodist holiness writer (Amazing Grace, 1923; Spiritual Gifts, 1900), whose books share the surname on archive.org. No uids minted.
